description: Negative fixtures for ChaosInjector.registerFault: malformed fault configurations that must fail loudly at registration time (see src/chaos.ts assertValidFaultConfig). Malformed probability types and unknown fault types previously registered silently and never fired; this fixture pins the explicit-error contract. Privacy-safe: contains no secrets, credentials, payment proofs, or request payloads.
